decisions.reason: The illuminated candle arch sits close to the core seasonal offer and was featured prominently, so it likely meets aspirations and gives no trigger for problemistic search, though seasonal lines do rotate over time.
A one-tier pyramid is the firm's core product type, built on established workshop routines at low cost, so it likely performs at aspiration and stays in the range.

Despite being distant from the core, the flagship music box line represents a strategic commitment, and demand for home décor during the pandemic years likely provided enough slack to keep carrying it.
This low-visibility accessory is vulnerable after four years without evidence of success, but it complements the flagship line and costs little, so keeping it remains slightly more likely.
This seasonal motif platform is a minor, distant add-on that may be pruned if the music box line underperforms, but its low resource needs and tie to the flagship favor keeping it for now.
The Dresden-themed pyramid builds directly on core competencies and appeals to the collectible market, so it likely remains at or above aspiration.
